Fact IDs / code affected:

## Evidence review

- [ ] Each new fact starts as `needs_review` with `review: null`.
- [ ] Every material claim has a primary source, date, short evidence passage and precise locator.
- [ ] Paraphrases are labelled `summary`, exact quotations `quote`; full reports and official summaries are distinguished.
- [ ] Date precision, historical scope, later corrective actions, denominators, uncertainty and allegations are preserved.
- [ ] No duplicate claim, fabricated padding, private personal data, or targeted political persuasion.
- [ ] Exact post includes a source URL and fits 500 code points including `Scheduled post · `.
- [ ] `npm run check` passes, and generated `public/facts.json` is included.
